title: Picking the Beans

readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Do you remember the day you planted these beans? Three seeds in each hole, one stick apart.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Look at them now! It's time to pick them. Let's fill a basket for each table at the supper.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Put the bean pods in the baskets: the number on each basket.
steps.hint: Count the pods as you put them in.

older.prompt: Read the number on each basket, and count that many pods in.

feedback.full: This basket has its {n}. Try another.
feedback.all_good: So many beans, from those few little seeds!

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: Remember the mustard seed? Something tiny, given time and care, grows into something wonderful. Thank God for the harvest!

journal_line: I picked the beans I planted on my very first day.
